scope: Mechanism identification and a bounded same-response decision-preservation pilot; not a validated new method

data.edit_stream: pinned existing fixed10k order, first1000, development data

DEC_LINE.role: B1 decision objective/acceptance and one-direction control

DEC_FUNCTIONAL.space: P_allowed plus current coefficient inequalities and actual finite guard

decision_method.reference_margin: W0 token logit minus strongest other token at fixed W0 prefix
decision_method.reference_document_margin: minimum across all valid generated positions
decision_method.direction_risk: reference_risk + history_risk; equal normalized blocks, fixed convention
decision_method.no_op: both risks zero, no tie mismatch, all required guards valid
decision_method.gradient_factor: A_i=gradient of exposed worst pair with respect to every valid input-token module output
decision_method.basis: top3 randomized/operator components plus exact residual of -grad(direction_risk) Q_E, then one activation-covariance direction
decision_method.orthonormalization: Frobenius, report rank, residual, projected-gradient span error and extra-direction angle
decision_method.coefficient_jacobian: J_ik=inner(A_i,D_k K_i), same center, same exposed pair
decision_method.proposal_radius: Psi_native / norm(projected gradient of Psi); zero-gradient branch mandatory
decision_method.solver: two-phase convex QCQP: minimize reference squared slacks subject to safe/nonregression rows, hard history and radius; then min coefficient norm at first-phase optimum within tolerance
decision_method.reference_local_nondegradation: mu_i+J_i a >= min(mu_i,0) for every document
acceptance: Current successful preference and target-strict IDs unchanged; per-request desired NLL within numerical tolerance
Declared current full-token response and actual logit invariant
All active Past meet entry-anchored guards
No new choice mismatch on ANY reference token safe at native, including inside unsafe documents
Every reference document worst deficit nonincreasing within numerical tolerance
Reference risk nonincreasing, combined risk meaningfully decreasing, total choice mismatches nonincreasing
All512 documents and all actual valid positions checked with full-vocabulary competitors
decision_method.finite_trials_exhausted: FINITE_SEARCH_UNRESOLVED; native fallback with full violation accounting

history.registry: all received versions, latest-valid subject/relation active
history.anchor: batch entry, not post-native and not W0 old target

evaluation.current_R_P_N: entry current N; own-native and selected current R/P/N after seal
evaluation.reference512: every native/candidate used by selector and every selected commit
evaluation.active_history: every entry, native and candidate/selected guard
evaluation.primary_S10: final W0-correct N retention and all-seen NS

stage_gates.B1_to_S3: valid nonzero primary correction; Current invariant; full512 coverage; actual choice repair OR >=5% reference-risk reduction above numeric error; no observed PS/strict/joint loss versus N4
stage_gates.S3_to_S10: Primary CUM vs N4 on B3 all-seen: valid Current/history/reference, no observed PS/P-strict/R-and-two-P joint loss, and reduced W0-correct N gross loss or actual recovery; if passed, continue STEP as control regardless of its efficacy
stage_gates.shared_cost_accounting: count once in total study cost, charge all required shared work to each standalone method estimate; never divide shared work by arm count for the 2x gate

mechanism.same_entry_probe: N4 own-native B2 from W0 chain, STEP vs CUM, no commit

runtime_prerequisites_to_bind_before_exe: actual optimized runtime source and numerical parity receipt
W0/native weights, tokenizer, P_raw/P_star/native history identities
exact dataset/order/context and R512/Dev128 capsule hashes
numerical invariant thresholds inherited explicitly from verified EN
decision margin/risk and zero-risk/zero-gradient thresholds with repeated-endpoint error checks; distinct from exact choice-ID mask
QCQP solver, phase1/phase2 tolerances, primal residual and optimality-gap units
factor cache storage budget and streaming implementation
immutable selection and observer access separation
